caption:
This is 📍VV Puram Food street and this is the most iconic one. But there were some parts I liked and some parts I did not, have included mostly the ones I liked. But this street needs to up its hygiene level game yaar. I mean most of the food street vendors don’t wear gloves and I had issues with the water they use in the food.

Hope this improves someday.
